1.text: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,<sup foot_note="228301">1</sup>

footnotes.228301: - Alone, without another, indivisible with absolute and permanent unity and distinct from all else. The one and only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes and deeds.

footnotes.228302: - He who is absolute, perfect, complete, essential, self-sufficient and sufficient to meet the needs of all creation; the one eternally and constantly required and sought, depended upon by all existence and to whom all matters will ultimately return.

3.text: He neither begets nor is born,

4.text: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
